description:
Experience 85.55± acres in Lampasas County, Texas, a turnkey recreational property designed for hunting, outdoor living, and future improvements. With utilities already in place and excellent wildlife habitat, this property is ready to enjoy from day one.

A concrete homesite pad equipped with plumbing provides an excellent foundation for your future home or barndominium. The property also includes a hunter's cabin and walk-in cooler, making it well suited for weekend getaways or hunting season.

Infrastructure is already established with a water well, water meter, and electricity, along with buried water line piping that services wildlife and livestock watering stations throughout the property. A seasonal pond further enhances the habitat and recreational appeal.

The land supports a healthy population of white-tailed deer, with a low-fenced western boundary allowing for natural wildlife movement. Combined with being fully fenced, this property offers an excellent balance of accessibility, functionality, and outdoor recreation.

Whether you're looking for a hunting retreat, recreational ranch, or a place to build your dream home in Central Texas, this Lampasas County property is ready for its next owner.

Property Highlights:
✅ 85.55± acres in Lampasas County, TX
✅ Concrete homesite pad with plumbing installed
✅ Hunter's cabin and walk-in cooler
✅ Water well, water meter, and electricity in place
✅ Healthy white-tailed deer population
✅ Seasonal pond
✅ Buried water line infrastructure for wildlife and livestock watering stations
✅ Low fence on the western boundary
✅ Fully fenced property

For more information or to schedule a private showing, contact the Wise Land Team with Whitetail Properties Real Estate.
